Eve of Destruction Remaster 1.0
Windows x64
https://github.com/catsandsoup/eod-recomp

GET STARTED
Unzip the download and open eod.exe. Choose your North American PS2 game
ISO when asked. The app installs the game files and remembers them.
No disc extraction or command line is required.

CONTROLS
Xbox and PlayStation controllers are supported. Start + Select opens the
remaster menu; use the D-pad to navigate, shoulder buttons to change tabs,
A/Cross to select, and B/Circle to go back. F1 opens the menu by keyboard.

ONLINE
Host a lobby and share the Garage Code, join by code, or choose a LAN game.
The host selects the event and shared rules. Each driver chooses a car
and paint. Guests mark Ready, then the host selects Start Event.
End Race returns the party to the lobby. Close Lobby ends the session.
The remaster menu stays live during an online race.

AUDIO
Settings includes master and music volume. Your music library and volume
are local to your machine. Online includes a microphone toggle, mute others
and deafen. Microphone transmission starts off.

SETTINGS
Change graphics, controls, mods and audio in the remaster menu.
eodsetup.exe also provides Windows setup and save-import tools.

Bring your own North American PS2 copy (SLUS_209.10 v1.00).
No game data is included.

Report problems: https://github.com/catsandsoup/eod-recomp/issues
Credits and licences: https://github.com/catsandsoup/eod-recomp#legal-credits-and-licences
